svg.title: A million rows, two totals
svg.desc: The exact DECIMAL sum of exp(x) over 1,000,000 inputs is 21409584.593082927242132800 on Apache Spark 4.3.0 and 21409584.593082927234346100 on Databricks Photon. The sqrt control is 66673217.826320215037044800 on both. Of the nine functions, every one but sqrt differs.
